title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Fizzy Cherry Prefilled Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Fizzy Cherry offers a sparkling cherry soda-inspired vape experience that’s fresh, fruity, and uniquely fizzy. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml e-liquid refill container, designed to provide extended vaping enjoyment with the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. These pods feature advanced dual mesh coil technology, ensuring consistently smooth vapour and bold, authentic flavour. With an innovative automatic refill system and a leak-resistant design, refilling your pod is effortless and mess-free. Together, the pod and refill container provide up to 6000 puffs, offering a long-lasting and satisfying vape. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pods deliver a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine relief, perfect for adult vapers seeking convenience and premium performance. Replace the pod and refill container when empty for an uninterrupted vaping experience.
